review_description: Quoting process was a mission.Installers were professionals, very tidy and efficient, overall excellent job.

Custom Solar Power responded quickly and arranged a home inspection straight away. Michael arrived well-prepared with all the details about my existing solar setup and explained how a solar battery would work, keeping it simple, which I really appreciated, as I find the technical specs very overwhelming. Communication was great throughout, and I was kept up to date with the installation schedule. The team was punctual, tidy, and did a very neat job. They also showed me how to use the charger in an easy-to-understand way. Very happy with the service, professional, efficient, and friendly!

Custom Solar Power was great from start to finish. Zaren was more than happy to answer all my questions about the system without a fuss.You can get a cheaper install elsewhere but you'll pay for it in half a decade. The installation was phenomenal, extremely clean and tidy and really quick considering everything.I'd recommend these lads to anybody if you want a premium install and peace of mind.

Cant give CSP team enough praise, best quoting process, best quote, best installation, best after installation customer service.All CSP staff are enthusiastic and committed to providing the best product and service to support your energy needs. I had additional solar panels and battery installed, they were punctual, quick, neat and happy to show me how my system worked.The CSP developed software to assist with selling power to the grid is exceptional.  Their support with my learning curve was and is highly admirable.

The whole process from sales to installation and commissioning was professional and efficient. They were patient and informative answering many questions and revising my quote quite a few times as I changed my mind on equipment. Installers were great, did a tidy job, and fullfilled all of my requests regarding installation specifics like inverter location, cabling routes, moved a conduit I realised would clash with future works without fuss. They then ran me through everything once commissioned and made sure I had the monitoring app working. System was up and running 100% the day installation was completed, this was instantly reflected in our metered usage the next day. Exceeded expectations and I feel confident about receiving ongoing support should it be required. 100% will be my first call when I want a battery, which can be added very easily now because CSP correctly rationalised the additional cost of a hybrid inverter in the initial solar only installation, the system is already setup for backup which means the battery is virtually a plug in addition and also comes with the benifit of excellent monitoring via the app as the whole house load now runs through the inverter, regardless of if it's pulling from solar or grid.

Initially communication was poor with install date being pushed back and installer not arriving on time. These difficulties were mainly due to factors affecting the battery industry generally outside of Custom Solar Power's control.The installed solution's integrations weren't to my expectation, but CSP then worked hard to provide a solution that I was happy with and continue to work with me until 3rd party integrations are working. The unmet expectations were due to factors outside of CSPs control.Zaren went above and beyond to help customise my solution to what I wanted and continues to be helpful well after the initial install.
Sales/quoting was direct and positiveInstallation went punctual and tidyCustomer service is excellent

Zarren, MD of Custom Solar Power, was very helpful and friendly when he came onsite to quote for our system. He was thorough in explaining the various options available to us and the process and cost involved for each option. (We had spoken to 3 other installers prior to CSP - none had Zarren's in-depth knowledge of the solar industry and his expertise.)On the day of installation, the team arrived on time, and were efficient, polite and professional. The installation process went very smoothly; on completion the team leader explained how the inverter worked and helped to install the app onto my iPad. Indeed, from start to finish it was a seamless experience - I highly recommend Zarren and the CSP team.

Hardware: batteries + new hybrid inverter (Sungrow/Sungrow), Solar panel expansion (Aiko), additional dongle for remote power trading control.Sales/quote: performed an onsite inspection, answered all my questions (I kept thinking of more), and gave thoughtful considerations to all my requests and suggestions (around waste, recycling, panel placement, priorities for environmental impact vs cost efficiency, future proofing, EV expansions - I have a difficult site). Provided quotes in a timely manner, provided all data sheets and warranties for me to peruse. They were realistic about what I could expect, and accommodated my requests. Provided a variety of options for hardware, and for energy provider set ups.Install: Timely, friendly and polite, well resourced with knowledgeable staff on site, put in an extra light in my dark little shed, tidied up everything after. Took away old equipment. Changed over my hot water system (from off peak).Customer service: Answered extra questions and confirmed my preferences again on the day of the install. Performed grid connection. Talked me through different components, switches and trouble shooting and then provided me with photos along with instruction manual. They sent follow up emails to make sure I was happy and everything was working well. They were also careful to time their connections/contracts/install to ensure I was taking advantage of the battery rebate.Energy trading: They set up a dongle and helped me assign them permission to trade on my behalf. They set up sensible initial parameters for battery and AEMO spot price trading decisions. I didn't realise that they would be in touch again - but they emailed me to let me know when my inverter connection had cut out, then called me soon after to follow up and make sure I'd been able to fix it, and then rediscussed my energy usage, and made plans to tweak their algorithm to make my trading efficiency even better. They micro manage for me, but there is flexibility if I want to change things manually, and I can watch everything in the Sungrow app.Based on their recommendations, management, and installation, I am approximately $600-700 better off per quarter than I was before with Origin energy as a provider, no battery, and a smaller panel array. By bill for the first 29 days was -$59.35. 2 months after the installation, and they are about to tighten up the trading parameters based on my data so far.

The quoting service showed a lot of patience with my detailed requests and changes in specificationsThe installation was very professional and the finish looks neat and cleanThe whole process was excellent from first contact to finished product
The sales process was easy.  Professional company and the staff were fantastic.  Customer service brilliant I would recommend Custom Solar Power.

Sales quoting was engaged and we were able to determine all the must have features to help choose the right technology for our site.The installation team we on time polite, friendly and very efficient getting the job done on time.  Customer service post installation has been excellent with appropriate follow up to get the system working perfectly and ensuring we were properly configured.The system was installed a couple of weeks before the cyclone and we had power for all of the 6 day black out.  Great Result the SIGEN technology delivered on all our requirements.

The quote provided was one of the best proposals I have seen from any vendor, in any industry. It was broken down enough to understand what you were paying for and also the projected savings with power analysis was excellent.The team were very professional, knowledgeable and punctual. They showed great patience throughout the installation when other roof problems were identified and inclement weather interrupted the installation. The explanation of the system was also excellent. I have referred Custom Solar Power to other friends already and would recommend them to anyone wanting more than the average solar system installer.

From obtaining the quote through to finished install and beyond, Zaren, Leigh and the team were fabulous. They were efficient, patient, had good attention to detail and left the place immaculate and the install looking top notch. They even arranged to come a few weeks before the solar/battery install to install an EV charger.Customer Service since install has been great also. There have been some minor software issues with the new PW3 and Zaren has been quick to get onto Tesla and get them sorted remotely for me.All in all a great experience from a company who clearly care about the quality of workmanship and customer service.

Enjoying my new solar system installed September 2024. The team at Custom Solar Power were very helpful through all stages; initial system design and advice, installation and post installation service.I would recommend Custom Solar Power to family and friends.

We chose CSP for their knowledge and explanation of the advantages of installing a battery to supplement our existing solar cells.  The quote was competitive, and the sales team were very helpful.  The installation was quick and efficient, and they handled all the paperwork.  We were given a brief run down on the system after installation, however since then the after sales advice and response to our subsequent queries has been exceptional.  I would definitely recommend CSP for anyone wanting to go the solar battery route.
Great team and awesome to deal with. Super fast service. I love it!

Custom Solar Power from start to finish provided excellent service when having our Inverter replaced.  Zaren Henderson and his team provided friendly advice, and organisation of the job by Natasha was very professional.  If you are looking for a professional company to supply and install solar power to your premises, I would recommend you contact Custom Solar Power.  You will not be disappointed.

Good dialogue with the company, Custom Solar Power, prior to deciding on the system that suited. The quotation was comprehensive and clear and included warranty information on the system components. Pricing was reasonable compared to others we received.Installation was done in half a day by a very professional team. They also organised the grid connection and, three months on everything is working smoothly. Highly recommend Custom Solar Power.

Custom Solar Power are by far the best solar installer in the state. They installed high quality products promptly and without fuss. Their quote was extremely competitive and their customer service was outstanding. Highly recommend!

Custom Solar Power are prompt and courteous and they have a high level of knowledge and experience. The installation was done efficiently and is of excellent quality.Unfortunately we've had some issues with the inverter however Custom Solar Power response was prompt and they handled the warranty claim with the manufacturer.

Custom Solar Power were so easy to deal with. No pushy sales and took the time to explain everything and answer all the questions I had.The installation team were so professional, polite and efficient and gave me a high sense of confidence in their knowledge and skills.Overall a quality product installed by quality trades. After sales has been top notch too! Highly recommend!
Great experience, amazing customer service and quality install. Highly recommend.

We had an amazing experience with this highly professional company. Superb customer service, always punctual, exceptionally knowledgeable sales staff … the whole experience from quoting to installation was seamless.  Every single tradesperson was lovely and polite, always on time and exceptional attention to detail. We are so happy with our new solar power system and are saving thousands in electricity. Very highly recommended.
Everything that needed to be done was done professionally and promptly.

How fortunate we were to luck onto Zaren and his team.Professional, thorough, first class come immediately to mind.Passionate about solar and happy to share their knowledge and experience.So satisfied were we that we paid for CSP to travel from Brisbane to Noosa to install panels, a battery and EV charging at our son’s home.
Everything from quoting to installation went smoothly.Installation was fast and professional.

After seeking multiple quotes from reputable installers, CSP were the first company to offer a face-to-face consultation and onsite quote. CSP provided multiple recommendations, system designs and quotes and for consideration before locking in a competitive solution to suit my project. Products, installation and workmanship is of a high standard and slight changes to the system design were explained and executed well during the install.Sales, Installation and Management teams were polite and a pleasure to deal with. After sales technical support was solid. CSP attended the property to inspect the system when needing to verify smart meter configuration and export data shortly after commissioning previous day.
Everything went smoothly from start to finish.Very prompt, professional and friendly.

From my power billing invoice, I sensed I had a problem with my solar panels. I called Zaren Henderson at Custom Solar Power and he was out checking my old system in a matter of days.They immediately discovered that I had some non-functioning panels, and was told that I would be sent a quote for the replacement of a similar size solar group that I had.I received a quote the next morning, and because of my lack of knowledge of solar panels I did have some questions which Zaren was there to answer. After I accepted the quote it was no time and he had his working party were ready to come and do the installation. It went like clockwork. The team was here on time, they got to work, and before I knew it the old panels were dismantled and removed, and the new ones were being installed. It was all over in no time, and the property was left clean and tidy. Zaren did explain the Sunnyboy panel and the connection to the grid, and also set up the monitoring software, to allow me to keep an eye on it. I would highly recommend  Custom Solar Power to anyone that is looking for a good solar panel installer that cares about the customer, and is thorough at explaining the system. Custom Solar Power is the one!!

The guys at Custom Solar Power were great. Prompt and friendly service. They were kind to the kids and the dog and the end result was great. They connected us to the grid so by the time they left we were already utilising our new solar system.

Customer service was efficient and friendly. Apart from the noise to remove the old panels they were quite which was lovely as I was working. I was given information and access to an app and the grid connection was organised for me. I hope and expect the system will be value for money and of high quality but time will tell.

Couldn't be happier with the guys at Customer Solar Power! Very glad I went with the battery option, slightly larger outlay but now we don't pay anything for our electricity bill!Thanks Zaren and the team!

We had the above installed and everything went very well. Quote was informative. Installation went very well and we were surprised at how smoothly it all went. We have had the system running now for a few months and it has lived up to expectations.
CSP took the time to understand my requirements and answer my questions. I thought the components of the system represented good value for money and I appreciated that they used their own installers.

The removal of old panels from 2006 installation was carried out in a timely fashion so that the roof could be cleaned and repainted. New panels were installed on time but a shortage of Fronius inverters prevented the completion of the installation. Throughout the delayed supply of the inverter, the company maintained contact appropriately and as soon as the equipment arrived, installation was completed today (Saturday) as was reestablishment of the grid connection so that the system was fully operational by lunch. The removal of all waste was completed satisfactorily, including the removal of the old system inverter.
